title: Andhra Pradesh Launches 'Pillale Sampada' (Children are Wealth) Population Initiative
summary: Offers ₹30,000 for 3rd child and ₹40,000 for 4th child to tackle declining fertility.

blocks.content: Offers ₹30,000 for 3rd child and ₹40,000 for 4th child to tackle declining fertility.

items: Demographic Incentive: Financial assistance of ₹30,000 for 3rd child birth and ₹40,000 for 4th child birth.
Policy Vision: Tackles declining fertility and rapid population ageing in southern states under 'Swarna Andhra 2047'.

blocks.summary: Andhra Pradesh CM: N. Chandrababu Naidu | Per capita target ₹55 lakh by 2047.
